column6: An everyday walk at a steady pace, arms swinging loosely. One stride cycle, in place
Swordplay: from a guard, a lunge forward with the sword arm thrust straight out
A zombie's shamble: head and shoulders slumped forward, a dragging step
A gorilla: hunched, knuckles low, a rolling heavy walk
A robot, acted by a person: stiff, jerky steps and arm moves in straight lines
Jumping jacks: hop the feet apart while the arms swing up overhead
A boxer's guard: fists up by the face
From the guard, a straight jab with the lead fist, snapped back to the guard
Climbing a ladder hand over hand
Sweeping the floor with a broom, steady strokes (no broom is drawn)
Washing a window: one hand wiping in circles at head height (no window is drawn)
A spinning jump kick (a tornado kick): a run-up
Toppling forward flat onto the face
A cartwheel to the side: hands to the floor one after the other
A steady run, arms pumping. One stride cycle, in place
Sneaking: crouched low, stepping carefully, arms held in close
Limping on a wounded leg: a short careful step on the bad leg
Standing a little hunched, looking warily about
Crouching to search the ground, peering about and poking at it
Walking hunched over, a hand clutching the stomach
Walking backwards at an easy pace. One cycle, in place
Walking crouched low on deeply bent knees. One cycle, in place
Hopping on the left foot, the right held up, arms out for balance
A run that skids to a sudden stop, leaning back to brake
Running, a leap over an obstacle, and running on
Running, ducking low under something, and running on
Running, a dive forward over something into a shoulder roll, back up and running
A jump straight up with a full spin in the air, landing facing forward again
Breakdance: on the floor
A fighter's punch combination from a guard: jabs, crosses and hooks
Blocks from a fighting stance: forearm blocks high, middle and low
A karate front kick (mae-geri): knee up, foot snapped straight ahead
A karate roundhouse kick (mawashi-geri)
A karate side kick (yoko-geri): the body turned side on
Karate stepping punches (oi-zuki)
Getting up from lying face down: push up on the arms
Getting up from lying on the back: sit up, roll to a knee, stand
Getting up from lying on the side
Ducking from something thrown
Chopping wood: an axe raised overhead in both hands and brought down hard
Digging with a spade: foot on the blade, lever back
Fishing: a cast with a rod, waiting, then reeling in (no rod is drawn)
Drinking a glass of water
Moving a heavy box: squat, lift with effort, carry a few steps
Raking leaves with long pulls toward the feet (no rake is drawn)
Shaking hands with someone in front
Walking up to a box, bending to lift it
Sitting down on a chair and getting up again (no chair is drawn)
Waving hello with a raised hand
A shrug: shoulders up, palms turned out, who knows
A big stretch with a yawn, arms reaching up overhead
A curtsey: one foot behind, knees dipping, a small bow of the head
Waiting impatiently: shifting weight from foot to foot, looking about
Frankenstein's monster: stiff legs, arms held straight out ahead
A monkey, acted by a person: hunched, scratching, hopping about
A bear, acted by a person: heavy, lumbering, rearing up with paws raised
A dragon, acted by a person: arms as wings, a prowl and a roar
A ghost, acted by a person: gliding, arms floating up, a spooky drift
A chicken, acted by a person: elbows as flapping wings, pecking, strutting
A standing backflip: a deep swing of the arms, a jump up and over backwards
